title: The Simon Peck Summer Series Award
text:
From Louise, our Chair:

At the end of the Summer Series 2016 there will be the opportunity for Club Members to nominate individuals for the Simon Peck Summer Series Award 2016 for the most enjoyable/ challenging event, the most ingenious/ devious/ frustrating event, the most improved orienteer over the series or for any other reason connected to this summer's events.

Please send your nominations to Louise at chair@suffoc.co.uk stating who you wish to nominate, which category and why.

Nominations will close at the end of July. Louise will select who she thinks is the most deserving based on your nominations. The award will be presented at our first colour-coded event of the Autumn, in Ickworth Park on 25th Sept.
